diagnosis: The TriggerEmailVerification gRPC handler triggers email verification tokens for any user specified in req.UserId. An attacker can spam verification tokens to arbitrary target executives or trigger rate limits that lock victim accounts out of completing onboarding flows.
exploit_request:
GRPC /notifications.v1.NotificationService/TriggerEmailVerification
Host: notifications.platform.internal:50051
Metadata: authorization: Bearer caller_token
